app_fee.value: The application fee is $50 for all applicants.

fee_waiver.value: No application-fee waiver appears on the fetched admissions, requirements or guide pages.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not requested and are not reviewed for admission.
gre_general.quote: GRE and TOEFL scores are not requested on our application and will not be reviewed as part of the admissions process.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL scores are not requested or reviewed, and the application lists no English test.
toefl_min.quote: All documents listed below must be submitted to complete your application | GRE and TOEFL scores are not requested on our application and will not be reviewed as part of the admissions process.

ielts_min.value: No IELTS or other English certificate is among the application documents.
ielts_min.quote: All documents listed below must be submitted to complete your application | A Curriculum Vitae (CV) or Resume

also.quote: GRE and TOEFL scores are not requested on our application and will not be reviewed as part of the admissions process.

english_waiver.value: The application does not say whether an English test or English-medium degree is accepted in place of one.

notes: Rockefeller runs one graduate application for its doctoral programs (The David Rockefeller Graduate Program). Doctoral programs on the official list: Biological Sciences (PhD 09328) and Physics (PhD 09332). Chemical biology and computational biology PhDs are Tri-Institutional programs run with MSK and Weill Cornell, not saved here. Stipend: $55,620 for 2026-27 on the housing page; the requirements PDF says $55,600 (undated). Fee waiver not found on any fetched page.
